intent: I'm about to replace my ancient point-and-shoot and the listings are screaming at me: 64 megapixels, 40x zoom, AI-enhanced clarity. My old camera was 12 megapixels and honestly its pictures looked fine printed. Before I pay extra for big numbers I want to know which of these claims mean something physically and which are marketing, especially the difference between real zoom and the cropped kind, and whether more pixels on a tiny chip can actually backfire. Buyers who fell for these promises must have written about it somewhere. Tell me which specs to trust and then name a camera that isn't lying to me.
